name: x-session-reader
description: Read posts and bookmarks visible to a user-provided or browser-session-bridge X/Twitter web session, without bypassing login or anti-bot checks.

X_COOKIES.prompt: Optional fallback X/Twitter cookies as a JSON array exported from your browser, or as a raw Cookie header. The tool first tries the chat's browser-session-bridge x.com session.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.prompt: Optional Chrome/Chromium executable path. Defaults to Playwright's cached Chromium.

HEADLESS.prompt: Run browser headless: true or false.

BROWSER_CACHE_MAX_MB.prompt: Maximum Chromium disk/media cache budget in MiB for each temporary X reader profile; temporary profiles are removed after use.
